tasks.goal: Traverse reserve boundary trails to build an occupancy map of canopy gaps and trail edges for biodiversity outcome tracking.
tasks.terrain: Wet, muddy cloud-forest trails with exposed roots, volcanic rock, mist-slick slopes and dense understory vegetation
success: Map covers >=90% of planned trail extent
safety_stops: E-stop if pitch >25 deg
Stop if wheel slip exceeds 30%
Stop for human-detected wildlife within 2 m
Battery <20% triggers return-to-start
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward approves transect route before launch and confirms mapped canopy-gap findings for the Progress Observatory.

tasks.goal: Walk to fixed orchid and bromeliad study plots and capture close-up imagery of epiphyte health for evidence summaries.
tasks.terrain: Narrow forest footpaths, fallen branches, moss-covered stones, persistent wet leaf litter and fog
success: Stand still <2 mm drift during capture
safety_stops: Stop if foot slip detected on wet moss
E-stop on body pitch >30 deg
Stop if LiDAR shows obstacle <0.3 m ahead
Thermal guard if motor temp >70 C
tasks.human_in_loop: Researcher selects the plot locations and validates epiphyte health classifications before synthesis.

tasks.goal: Climb steep reserve slopes to place and photograph 1 m quadrat frames along survey lines for species-count evidence.
tasks.terrain: Steep muddy inclines up to 35 deg, slippery leaf litter, buttress roots, dense fog reducing visibility
success: Place 8 quadrats within 5 cm of target coordinates
safety_stops: Auto-sit if slope >40 deg
Stop if payload arm misaligned
Stop on human proximity <1.5 m
Low battery return-to-dock
tasks.human_in_loop: Field scientist approves quadrat coordinates and reviews photos for species counts.

tasks.goal: Fly quiet dawn patrols above the canopy gap near Charter Hall to record bird and frog vocalizations for biodiversity metrics.
tasks.terrain: Open canopy gap with emergent tree crowns, shifting fog layers, light rain and gusty updrafts on ridge edges
success: Hold 10 m altitude station-keep within 0.3 m
Record 10 min of usable audio at 3 waypoints
Safe landing within 0.2 m of pad
safety_stops: Land immediately if wind gust >8 m/s
Return if battery <3.7 V
Stop if any obstacle within 1 m
Cease flight in rain detected on hull sensor
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward approves flight plan and confirms vocalization identifications for the charter's measurable outcomes.

tasks.goal: Pick and place labeled soil and water sample vials from field carriers into the lab rack for the Task Router's working groups.
tasks.terrain: Field station bench with wet sample carriers, condensation on vials, uneven rack slots
success: Placement within 2 mm of slot center
safety_stops: Stop if force/torque exceeds 20 N or 1.5 Nm
Stop on human within 0.5 m of workspace
Abort if gripper slip detected
Pause if vial barcode unreadable twice
tasks.human_in_loop: Lab technician approves rack layout and verifies chain-of-custody for each sample batch.

tasks.goal: Present proposal summaries and gesture to evidence displays for stewards before their human-only votes.
tasks.terrain: Flat boardroom floor, loose cables, chairs, occasional wet shoe prints from foggy entrance
safety_stops: Sit down if tilt >15 deg
Stop motion if human within 0.4 m
Pause speech on steward hand-raise
Stop if battery <15%
tasks.human_in_loop: People alone cast final votes and enact proposals; Nao only presents drafts for debate.

tasks.goal: Reach canopy-level sensor masts with both arms and recalibrate wind and humidity sensors mounted at 1.8 m height.
tasks.terrain: Gravel clearing with guy-wire anchored masts, wet grass, sensor cables at ankle height
success: Arm positioning within 1 cm of sensor face
safety_stops: Stop if foot detects cable entanglement
E-stop on any balance disturbance
Stop if wind >10 m/s near masts
Human within 1 m of mast aborts arm motion
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward verifies recalibration readings before they enter progress tracking records.

tasks.goal: Gently transplant endangered native seedlings between nursery trays while logging growth-stage measurements for the contribution model.
tasks.terrain: Nursery bench with soft peat trays, delicate stems, wet soil, variable seedling heights 3-15 cm
success: Transplant 24 seedlings with zero stem damage
Grip force under 2 N on stems
safety_stops: Release immediately if force >2 N
Stop on human entry to workspace
Pause if seedling not detected clearly
Abort if soil moisture makes gripper slip twice consecutively
tasks.human_in_loop: Ecologist approves transplant schedule and confirms growth-stage labels for the contribution model.
